name: CloseAgent
summary: CloseAgent is a semi-automated utility EA that closes existing positions based on Bollinger Bands and RSI overbought/oversold signals. It does not open new trades but monitors open positions and exits them when price hits the upper/lower Bollinger Band with confirming RSI extremes. An optional global profit target can close all positions at once when account profit reaches a threshold.
summary_zh: CloseAgent是一个半自动化工具型EA，基于布林带和RSI超买超卖信号来关闭已有持仓。它不开仓新交易，而是监控已有头寸并在价格触及布林带上下轨且RSI确认极端值时平仓。可选的全局盈利目标可在账户利润达到阈值时一键平掉所有持仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA是一个纯平仓工具，不涉及任何开仓逻辑，仅用于管理已有持仓的退出。出场条件：对于多头仓位，当Bid价突破上轨(UBB)且RSI大于70且当前价高于开仓价时平仓；对于空头仓位，当Ask价跌破下轨(LBB)且RSI小于30且当前价低于开仓价时平仓。此外还有全局盈利平仓功能：当账户总利润超过CloseAll设定值时关闭所有仓位。仓位管理：该EA完全不涉及开仓和仓位管理，仅负责平仓操作。资金管理：唯一的资金管理手段是CloseAll参数，可在账户整体盈利达标时全部平仓，但没有单笔止损或追踪止损机制。指标使用：布林带(周期21，偏差2)判断价格极端位置，RSI(周期13)确认超买超卖，两者结合作为均值回归的出场信号。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA is a pure closing utility with no entry logic whatsoever, designed solely to manage exits of existing positions. Exit conditions: For long positions, it closes when Bid exceeds the upper Bollinger Band, RSI is above 70, and the current price is above the entry price; for short positions, it closes when Ask falls below the lower Bollinger Band, RSI is below 30, and the current price is below the entry price. Additionally, a global profit-close feature closes all positions when total account profit exceeds the CloseAll threshold. Position sizing: The EA has no position sizing logic as it never opens trades, only closes them. Money management: The only money management mechanism is the CloseAll parameter for account-level profit taking, but there is no per-position stop loss or trailing stop. Indicator usage: Bollinger Bands (period 21, deviation 2) identify price extremes, RSI (period 13) confirms overbought/oversold conditions, and the combination serves as a mean-reversion exit signal.

parameters.name: CloseMode
parameters.description: 平仓模式：0=仅手动交易，1=仅算法交易，2=两者皆平

parameters.name: WTimeframe
parameters.description: 指标计算使用的时间周期

parameters.name: OperationMode
parameters.description: 操作模式：0=当前K线实时计算，1=新K线开始时计算

parameters.name: CloseAll
parameters.description: 账户总盈利平仓阈值，0表示禁用

parameters.name: EnableAlerts
parameters.description: 是否启用平仓警报通知

pros: 结合布林带和RSI双确认，避免单一指标误判导致的过早平仓
支持手动交易和算法交易的筛选，灵活控制平仓范围
全局盈利平仓功能可作为账户级别的资金保护机制
LiveBar和NewBar两种操作模式适应不同交易场景的需求
pros_en: Dual confirmation with Bollinger Bands and RSI reduces the risk of premature exits from single-indicator false signals
Magic number filtering allows selective closing of manual vs algo trades, giving flexible control over position scope
The global profit-close feature serves as an account-level money management safeguard
LiveBar and NewBar operation modes adapt to different trading scenarios and resource usage needs
cons: 没有任何止损机制，若市场单边剧烈波动，持仓可能遭受巨大亏损而无法自动平仓
指标句柄在每次循环迭代中重复创建但从未释放，会造成严重的内存泄漏和资源浪费
账户利润变量acp在全局作用域初始化后永不更新，导致CloseAll功能完全失效
缺少点差过滤，在M5小周期上布林带突破信号可能被点差噪音干扰
cons_en: No stop loss mechanism exists; if the market moves violently in one direction, positions can suffer massive losses without automatic closing
Indicator handles are created inside every loop iteration but never released, causing severe memory leaks and resource waste
The account profit variable acp is initialized at global scope and never updated, rendering the CloseAll feature completely non-functional
No spread filter is implemented, so on M5 timeframe Bollinger Band breakout signals can be corrupted by spread noise
improvements: 将指标句柄创建移至OnInit()中，在OnDeinit()中释放，避免内存泄漏并提升性能
修复acp变量，在MyAlgo()每次调用时重新获取AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_PROFIT)以确保CloseAll功能生效
添加单笔持仓止损和追踪止损功能，增强风险控制能力
添加点差过滤和滑点保护，提高在小周期和低流动性环境下的可靠性
improvements_en: Move indicator handle creation to OnInit() and release them in OnDeinit() to prevent memory leaks and improve performance
Fix the acp variable by refreshing AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_PROFIT) inside MyAlgo() on each call so the CloseAll feature actually works
Add per-position stop loss and trailing stop functionality to strengthen risk management capabilities
Add spread filter and slippage protection to improve reliability on low timeframes and in low-liquidity environments

risk_points: acp变量从未更新导致CloseAll全局盈利平仓功能完全失效，可能误导用户依赖一个不工作的安全机制
没有单笔止损，在布林带和RSI信号未触发前市场极端波动可能导致巨大亏损
指标句柄内存泄漏在长时间运行或持仓较多时会逐渐耗尽系统资源
risk_points_en: The acp variable is never updated, making the CloseAll global profit-close feature completely non-functional and potentially misleading users who rely on this safety mechanism
No per-position stop loss means extreme market moves can cause massive losses before Bollinger/RSI signals trigger
Indicator handle memory leaks can gradually exhaust system resources during long-running sessions or with many open positions
